about_item: 👓 FINALLY, HEADPHONES THAT LOVE YOUR GLASSES (4.7g Weightless Clip) Designed for ears that wear glasses first. The 4.7g feather-light clip rests around your ear with ZERO pressure on temples or ear canal. Ergonomic spring fits all ear shapes — from 8-hour workdays to long flights, forget you're wearing them.

🚴 YOUR MUSIC WITH 360° SAFETY (Open Ear Design) Run city streets, bike trails, or walk through crowds with full awareness. Open-ear design beams music in while keeping traffic, conversations, and alerts crystal clear. It's not just audio — it's your personal safety gear.

💪 SWEATPROOF GRIP FOR YOUR TOUGHEST WORKOUT (IPX6 & Secure Clip) The clip is engineered with 4-point support to lock securely during HIIT, sprints, and heavy lifts. IPX6 sweatproof + physical buttons work reliably with sweaty hands. Built for the grind.

🎮 STUDIO SOUND MEETS ZERO LAG (12mm Dual Drivers & Bluetooth 5.4) 12mm titanium drivers deliver rich bass without sacrificing awareness. Bluetooth 5.4 + 35ms low-latency mode ensures perfect sync for movies and competitive gaming. ENC keeps calls crystal clear in noisy gyms or windy outdoors.

🔋 40-HOUR FREEDOM & 5M+ COMMUNITY TRUST 6.5h continuous playtime extends to 40h with charging case. Quick-charge 10 min = 2h use. Backed by 1-year warranty and trusted by a global community of active users. Your adventure, powered up.

summary.text: Customers find these headphones crystal clear in sound quality and comfortable, with one noting they can wear them without any irritation. The headphones fit well, staying securely in place, and one customer mentions they work great for 30-mile bike rides. Customers appreciate their lightweight design, good battery life, and consider them good value for money, comparing them favorably to more expensive alternatives.
